summary: Woodside Energy Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing an ASX Appendix 3G notice dated October 8, 2026, covering the issue or transfer of 51,575 ordinary fully paid shares upon exercise or conversion of unquoted employee incentive securities, split as 50,885 shares issued September 1, 2026 and 690 shares issued October 1, 2026. The underlying WDSAL rights converted into existing quoted WDS shares via transfer of existing securities, not a new issuance. No KMP participated. This is a routine equity administration filing with no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics; no arbitrage angle exists.
